channel.title: Acme: W3C Changes
channel.description: Reports on substantive changes in W3C GitHub repositories.

item.title: SHACL Rules Refines Aggregation and Grouping
item.description:
The SHACL Rules draft defines evalAggregate more precisely and treats an omitted BY clause as an implicit single group. It also refines aggregation assignment and well-formedness rules, making aggregate evaluation less ambiguous.

Changes: data-shapes e0aedcd5b0; data-shapes 3bb77ff31f; data-shapes 5a9bd002d0.

item.title: HTML Ruby Clarifies Assistive Reading Behavior
item.description:
The HTML Ruby draft clarifies that ruby text is made available to a speech user agent in document order, without forcing it onto users who configured a different reading behavior.

Changes: html-ruby 263a2e2a19.

item.title: Attribution Reporting Explains DAP Confidentiality Assumptions
item.description:
The Attribution Reporting draft adds detail about distributed aggregation using two independent operators, including its reliance on sound HPKE encryption for report confidentiality. This clarifies the trust model of a developing privacy mechanism.

Changes: attribution 1e63b8dc31.

item.title: Japanese Layout Draft Expands Ruby Guidance
item.description:
The Japanese layout draft expands its discussion of ruby placement, distinguishing per-character readings from readings that apply to a whole compound word, with examples. The work remains draft typography guidance.

Changes: jlreq-d 411dc38f30.

item.title: WebCodecs Tightens Frame Validation and Privacy Guidance
item.description:
WebCodecs checks VideoFrame buffer allocation against coded dimensions. Its expanded privacy considerations also discuss limiting supported configurations to a common baseline to reduce fingerprinting entropy.

Changes: webcodecs 0755634aa3; webcodecs 5762c7bc07.

item.title: CSS Mixins Refines Private Properties and Function Arguments
item.description:
CSS Mixins permits @property inside @private and clarifies empty arguments and trailing commas in @function calls. The related Properties and Values API draft adds a shorthand form for @property. These are draft syntax changes, not evidence of broad browser support.

Changes: css-houdini-drafts 27d37c60b5; csswg-drafts 909869d6b5; csswg-drafts 5df2d97275.

item.title: Audio Working Group Charter Advances to Proposed Status
item.description:
The Audio Working Group charter text changed to proposed status. It remains a proposed charter, and the status change should not be read as completion of its prospective speech or audio deliverables.

Changes: charter-drafts 28a94796b5.

item.title: Data Integrity Draft Proposes Merkle Aggregation for Salted Hashes
item.description:
The Verifiable Credential Data Integrity draft adds a Merkle-tree approach to aggregating SHoC salted hashes. This is draft cryptographic data-integrity work; implementers should not infer deployed interoperability from the commit.

Changes: vc-data-integrity 2864e1c98a.

item.title: CSS Gaps Draft Defines Gap Segments
item.description:
The CSS Gaps draft defines a gap segment as the portion of a gap between successive endpoints along its centerline. That gives the draft a precise unit for describing how gaps are constructed and rendered.

Changes: csswg-drafts 7043197887.

item.title: SHACL UI Adds Suggested Values and Search Guidance
item.description:
SHACL UI draft text introduces non-constraining suggestedValues alongside static enumerations and dynamic lookup editors. It also refines how searchQuery retrieves candidate values and when a fallback to sh:in is allowed.

Changes: data-shapes 40231dfb97; data-shapes 3c8ab0eb48.

item.title: Vocabulary Generator Adds Scoped Individuals and Mermaid Output
item.description:
The yml2vocab tool adds a scope property for individuals in generated contexts and support for Mermaid diagram generation. These are tooling changes that help maintain W3C vocabularies, not normative vocabulary changes themselves.

Changes: yml2vocab 34deac7b34; yml2vocab ed2a4e743d.

item.title: High Resolution Time Extends Performance to AudioWorklet
item.description:
High Resolution Time defines access to performance.now() in AudioWorklet and clarifies creation of a performance object for WindowOrWorkerGlobalScope. The draft ties timing behavior to the relevant environment time origin.

Changes: hr-time 76c362ed31; hr-time 223875330d.

item.title: Linked Web Storage Charter Advances to AC Proposal
item.description:
The Linked Web Storage Working Group charter is now marked proposed to the W3C Advisory Committee. It remains a proposed charter; its deliverables and scope are not yet completed standards.

Changes: lws-wg-charter ced9bec88f.

item.title: Window Management Explainer Expands Always-on-Top Proposal
item.description:
The Window Management explainer and security questionnaire expand a proposal for standalone windows that can remain above other applications. This is exploratory design and threat review, not a shipped Web API.

Changes: window-management 2c2d0f95fb.

item.title: Web App Manifest Treats Text Members as Scalar Strings
item.description:
The Web App Manifest draft defines textual members such as name and short_name as scalar value strings. This clarifies Unicode string handling in application metadata.

Changes: manifest 7eaf743577.

item.title: Internationalization Tests Avoid Unsafe HTML Interpolation
item.description:
The W3C internationalization test harness now builds interface content with DOM methods instead of interpolating URL-supplied font names into HTML or inline JavaScript. That hardens interactive tests against untrusted input.

Changes: i18n-tests 7b0a88e266.

item.title: Geolocation Clarifies Accuracy Confidence Level
item.description:
The Geolocation specification now characterizes its accuracy value as a 68% confidence level, or one standard deviation, in meters. That makes interpretation of location uncertainty more precise.

Changes: geolocation ec43ad1327.

item.title: MathML Adds Internationalized Intent Examples
item.description:
MathML adds examples showing how intent can support spoken readings of mathematical expressions, including a distinction between literal superscript reading and an exponent reading. The examples illustrate accessibility and internationalization behavior.

Changes: mathml dd1fdc96d8.

item.title: IFT Encoder Improves Auto-Configuration and Glyph Analysis
item.description:
The Incremental Font Transfer encoder adds options for default OpenType features and code points in auto-configuration, includes ungrouped code points in overlapping-script analysis, and improves reporting of unreachable glyphs in Unicode-range mode. These are encoder implementation changes.

Changes: ift-encoder 07b2158b69; ift-encoder b4dee0a972; ift-encoder 550b6bbd30.

item.title: VCALM Test Suite Adds Normative Coverage Matrix
item.description:
The VCALM test suite derives normative statement coverage from the specification and tests workflow interfaces required by section 3.6. This is conformance-test infrastructure for the draft, not a protocol change.

Changes: vcalm-test-suite 418be2ab74; vcalm-test-suite 033a9cea8d.

item.title: RDF Syntax Drafts Correct Code-Point Descriptions
item.description:
Turtle, N-Triples and N-Quads drafts correct descriptions of code points and delimiters. The coordinated changes remove misleading character descriptions across related RDF syntaxes.

Changes: rdf-turtle 050e0398fc; rdf-n-triples 92329eae5a; rdf-n-quads 0d17f99bdc.

item.title: SVG Aligns Color and Interpolation with CSS Color 4
item.description:
SVG 2 updates its color definition and color-interpolation language to refer to CSS Color 4. The alignment reduces divergence between SVG paint behavior and the current CSS color model.

Changes: svgwg bc3d074bdc; svgwg ecab4ef400.

item.title: Incremental Font Transfer Corrects Patch Selection Steps
item.description:
The Incremental Font Transfer draft corrects patch-map selection steps and accompanying examples, including how equal intersections in a patch map are handled. A subsequent HTML update carries the overview changes into the rendered specification.

Changes: IFT 56e987829d; IFT 545a914b49.

item.title: Community Group Specs Clarify Lack of W3C Endorsement
item.description:
Shared Community Group specification assets now state more explicitly that incubation documents are not endorsed by W3C or ready for standardization. The notice helps readers distinguish community drafts from W3C Recommendations.

Changes: cg-spec-assets b7d8d654c7.

item.title: CSS Fonts Specifies Horizontal and Vertical Kerning Algorithms
item.description:
CSS Fonts 4 now gives explicit algorithms for horizontal and vertical kerning, including which font features to use for each writing direction. This narrows implementer ambiguity in typesetting.

Changes: csswg-drafts 0a718ceea2.

item.title: Media Queries Draft Adds a Bold-Text Preference Feature
item.description:
Media Queries 5 adds a proposed prefers-bold-text media feature to detect a system request for heavier text. It is draft accessibility-related CSS work; the commit does not establish implementation availability.

Changes: csswg-drafts b59a950b90.

item.title: WoT Bindings Clarify Binary Content and LoRaWAN Event Frequency
item.description:
Web of Things binding templates require application/octet-stream content types for binary PROFINET/S7 payload descriptions. A LoRaWAN extension adds defaultEventingFrequencyMinutes for a device’s configured periodic uplink interval.

Changes: wot-binding-templates d46e478850; wot-binding-templates ee64766783; wot-binding-templates 39c5f205ed.

item.title: RDF Tests Add Invalid-Syntax Cases and Async DELETE Outcome
item.description:
RDF test suites add negative syntax cases for bad IRIs and language tags. Graph Store Protocol tests also accept HTTP 202 for a DELETE request in designated cases, accounting for asynchronous processing.

Changes: rdf-tests 6b79fc7689; rdf-tests d1c8f77db7.

item.title: WAI Style Guide Adds Mobile Terminology Advice
item.description:
The WAI website style guide advises writers to avoid ambiguous use of mobile and name the relevant property, such as touch input or a small screen, particularly in normative text.

Changes: wai-website-theme 2d963ab817.

item.title: Managed Media Source Clarifies Streaming State and Events
item.description:
Media Source specifies ManagedMediaSource.streaming starts false, corrects monitoring of streaming state, fires endstreaming on detach, and avoids bufferedchange when ranges do not change. The related event order is defined after end of stream.

Changes: media-source 86ea3b786e; media-source 7aa0c54e7c; media-source 1895b1dc52; media-source 0684210def.

item.title: Profiles Vocabulary Links Terms to RDF Properties
item.description:
The Profiles Vocabulary draft explicitly associates terms such as hasResource, isProfileOf and hasToken with their RDF property definitions. This improves navigation between prose and machine-readable terms.

Changes: dx-prof 1ada8ff642.

item.title: Proposed ATAG Charter Updates Coordination and Leadership
item.description:
The Authoring Tool Accessibility Guidelines Working Group charter now identifies proposed chairs and describes coordination with other community groups. Its status is proposed, not an adopted Recommendation or a completed charter outcome.

Changes: charter-drafts 67d22d686b; charter-drafts 1413135c14.

item.title: SOSA/SSN Adds Planned Executions and Collections Example
item.description:
The SOSA/SSN work adds an example describing planned deployments and collections of observations, actuations or samples before those executions are complete. It illustrates how to represent intended future sensing activity.

Changes: sdw-sosa-ssn 9ab7f8f440.

item.title: Motion Sensors Fixes Timestamp and Geomagnetic Examples
item.description:
The Motion Sensors specification corrects timestamp arithmetic by converting elapsed milliseconds to seconds and fixes its geomagnetic vector reference. The changes make sample orientation calculations more reliable.

Changes: motion-sensors ccd67eb4d8.

item.title: WebTransport Revises Datagram Queues, Stats and Session Behavior
item.description:
WebTransport now permits user agents to cap outgoing datagram queues by bytes, defines per-session consistency for exposed statistics, and defaults outgoingMaxAge to Infinity while rejecting zero. Related changes address writable errors, empty BYOB datagrams, reception processing, connection pooling and exported keying material.

Changes: webtransport 91b5a73168; webtransport e00af0b1c3; webtransport c3004c766c; webtransport 3294f96671; webtransport 36098591d8; webtransport b5b2c11982; webtransport 62a91be1b3.

item.title: DID Registry Adds the agentid Method
item.description:
The DID extensions registry adds did:agentid with a link to its defining specification. Registration records the method identifier; it does not constitute W3C endorsement or standardization of the method.

Changes: did-extensions afdfdb6039.

item.title: CSS Link Parameters Refines Color Passing and Syntax
item.description:
Draft CSS Link Parameters adopts a colon between a param() name and value. Related CSS Environment work describes passing color and accent-color through environment values and a user-agent root rule. These changes refine an emerging mechanism for parameterized linked resources.

Changes: csswg-drafts f6a994be84; csswg-drafts 636a76a25e.

item.title: WebDriver BiDi Corrects Network Interception and Data Lookup
item.description:
WebDriver BiDi fixes the intercept phase assigned when network.responseStarted fires and corrects the collector lookup order in network.getData. Both changes target predictable automation behavior for network events and captured data.

Changes: webdriver-bidi 1445574f9e; webdriver-bidi 8e6313ad96.

item.title: DID Resolution Draft Removes Architecture Section
item.description:
The DID Resolution draft removes its architectures section, focusing the specification away from potentially inconsistent descriptions of resolver arrangements. This is a scope/editorial restructuring, not a new resolution method.

Changes: did-resolution ff918f21fd.

item.title: WCAG2ICT Refines Non-Web Application Guidance
item.description:
WCAG2ICT updates explain how several WCAG criteria apply to non-web documents and software, including keyboard use, contrast, purpose, pronunciation, focus appearance and error prevention. These are interpretive mappings, not new WCAG criteria.

Changes: wcag2ict 332fba20ff; wcag2ict 32b98aeb0f; wcag2ict e4aae6b673; wcag2ict 265c96523d; wcag2ict 4bcb3a4ca9; wcag2ict 553d4057b4.

item.title: Recognized Entities Publishes Draft Vocabulary Sources
item.description:
The Recognized Entities work adds an initial YAML-based vocabulary and scope information for terms, with generation of RDF serializations. This is evolving vocabulary infrastructure, not a finalized credential standard.

Changes: vc-recognized-entities ae5303d9b4; vc-recognized-entities 86de695744.

item.title: Encrypted Media Resolves Key and Capability Algorithm Details
item.description:
Encrypted Media clarifies interoperable encryption for media data, initializes MediaKeySession.keyStatuses, identifies the target MediaKeys object when a CDM becomes unavailable, and corrects capability, codec and session-type algorithm references. The package tightens implementation details rather than adding a new DRM system.

Changes: encrypted-media abe2867701; encrypted-media 84b34ba9a0; encrypted-media db8143b3ee; encrypted-media 1c007dcae7; encrypted-media 75aac824c7; encrypted-media 8491d104e5.

item.title: CSS Gradients Clarify Out-of-Gamut Interpolation
item.description:
CSS Images 4 requires out-of-gamut gradient colors to be CSS gamut-mapped, while CSS Color 4 explains how interpolation can produce colors outside a display gamut even when endpoints are in gamut. The paired changes clarify rendering expectations.

Changes: csswg-drafts 12ab907120; csswg-drafts a26d67b414.

item.title: CSS Fonts Defines Font Feature Value Serialization
item.description:
CSS Fonts 4 adds an algorithm for retrieving and serializing font-feature-value map attributes, including lowercasing the requested block type. It makes stylesheet object behavior more explicit for implementations.

Changes: csswg-drafts bfd05e08ef.

item.title: DID Methods Charter Marked Accepted
item.description:
The DID Methods Working Group charter was marked accepted, replacing a pending charter status and recording its term. The change concerns the group’s authorization, not approval of any particular DID method.

Changes: did-methods-wg-charter ea31126fde.

item.title: WCAG Understanding Material Expands Practical Guidance
item.description:
WCAG guidance adds a proposed failure technique for hover/focus content that cannot be dismissed, extends color-only chart guidance, and clarifies target size, authentication, error identification and markup techniques. These are explanatory and technique updates, not new WCAG success criteria.

Changes: wcag d1e063920a; wcag a9193fa8ed; wcag e73e4d34bf; wcag 9aa1212d83; wcag 32b5561840; wcag a66cdbaf03.

item.title: DCAT 3 Draft Clarifies Inherited Class Properties
item.description:
The DCAT 3 vocabulary specification updates class documentation to show inherited properties that were previously missing. The change improves how readers understand the data model without introducing a new property.

Changes: dx-dcat 9bc0aba067.

item.title: CSS Color 4 Refines Ray-Trace Gamut Mapping
item.description:
The CSS Color 4 draft revises its sample ray-tracing gamut-mapping algorithm for numerical edge cases. It clamps the achromatic anchor to the destination gamut and adjusts intersection calculations and tolerances, reducing rounding problems near the gamut boundary.

Changes: csswg-drafts 1cf991828d; csswg-drafts de8437bf9c; csswg-drafts 16d99fc592.

item.title: RDF Test Vocabulary Adds Syntax Format Property
item.description:
The RDF test vocabulary adds rdft:syntaxFormat to test subclasses, giving manifests a way to identify the syntax format under test. The associated manifest cleanup removes cross-version includes that could blur RDF 1.1 and 1.2 coverage.

Changes: rdf-tests 9fafbec5e6; rdf-tests 80b800352c.

item.title: Recognized Entities Draft Adds Registration Property
item.description:
The Verifiable Credentials Recognized Entities draft adds a registration property to describe how an entity is recorded in an issuer-maintained register, such as a business or accreditation register. Its UNTP example is updated to demonstrate the field.

Changes: vc-recognized-entities b6ecd6743c.

item.title: Recognized Entities Draft Tightens Retrieval Security and Time Limits
item.description:
The Recognized Entities draft adds guidance against server-side request forgery from unverified URLs and uses maxDuration and depth limits to bound retrieval chains. It also clarifies evaluation time and digestMultibase protection for externally referenced resources. These are draft security and verification rules.

Changes: vc-recognized-entities 13ff1d7ec0; vc-recognized-entities 36c632971a; vc-recognized-entities eb77f29f47; vc-recognized-entities 416d23e052; vc-recognized-entities a49cd97972.

item.title: SHACL Rules Draft Adds Grouping and Aggregation Example
item.description:
The SHACL Rules work adds an example illustrating grouping and aggregation and explains when those rules run relative to rules that produce their input data. The example helps distinguish aggregate rule evaluation from ordinary rule execution.

Changes: data-shapes 218d5803cf.

item.title: Encrypted Media Explainer Revises Embedded-Key Rotation Proposal
item.description:
An Encrypted Media explainer now proposes using the existing MediaKeySession.update() method for embedded keys instead of adding session-management APIs. This remains a proposal in an explainer, not a newly standardized EME behavior.

Changes: encrypted-media 7a5533c256.

item.title: DID Resolution Revises Results and HTTP Status Mapping
item.description:
The DID Resolution draft removes a separate DID URL Dereferencing Result section, requires defining specifications to provide URLs for error types, and specifies HTTP status behavior for complete and successful results. These changes sharpen interoperable resolution responses.

Changes: did-resolution 60ba893916; did-resolution c3febac372; did-resolution 1c9ceb1cf6.

item.title: Draft Agentic Web Charter Expands Identity and Threat-Model Scope
item.description:
The draft Agentic Web Working Group charter now covers two-way identity flows, delegation and interaction modes, measurement, and a privacy/security threat-model Note. The text discusses prompt injection, exfiltration, tracking and misleading outputs. These are proposed charter deliverables, not adopted standards.

Changes: charter-drafts a943ce5300; charter-drafts 019c05a0a9; charter-drafts c22e34d82b; charter-drafts 24c5314a1b.
